render_mesh_sequence: render a sequence of 3D mesh frames from OBJ files into a GIF or MP4 video
render_mesh_with_bones: render a mesh sequence with transparent surface and visible skeleton bones overlaid
render_mesh_with_camera_trajectory: render a mesh sequence with the camera trajectory visualization included in the scene
render_mesh_with_vertex_trajectory: render a mesh sequence showing the trajectory of selected vertices across frames
evaluate_mesh_with_chamfer_distance: render and evaluate mesh reconstruction quality using chamfer distance and F-score metrics against ground truth
